scope: Read-only literal native diagnostic, no artwork modification or acceptance
exactAlpha: round(255*clip((B-min(R,G)-3)/18,0,1)) restricted to retained original8-connected weak-purple components
explanation: A one-channel integer excess increment changes alpha by approximately14/255. Applying literal secondary lilac against a near-white source can therefore amplify original faint per-pixel chroma variation into visible lilac/white grain. The map uses existing source variations rather than random new noise; that preservation fact does not make the resulting visual grain acceptable.
